note: Independently specified hostile controls for the source-view / release-identity admission seam. Written from the declared law and the visible contract surface of the already-published WG0M parent return. WG0P6 code was NOT read before this oracle was committed.
parent_verdict: RED on exactly one frozen control: source/release_source_artifact
law: Contradictory copied descriptor/source metadata must be refused by typed admission before a new I03 call. Fact and authority attacks are measured only after constructing the genuine baseline; baseline queries are not attack-time execution. No original respondent/source authority or institutional acceptance is inferred.

preserved_inherited_suites.original_independent33: 32 PASS / 1 RED (the single RED is source/release_source_artifact, retained)
preserved_inherited_suites.retained_RED: source/release_source_artifact -- MUST remain RED unless physically falsified by real imported code and independently verified outputs

frozen_science_not_re_derived.cold: original 3-unit manifest; genuine accepted prior receipt; actual exit 23; fresh PID; 1+2 I03 calls; three original consumer results

controls.rationale: A genuine, correctly formed SOURCE_SNAPSHOT pointer belonging to a DIFFERENT release must not be admitted as this release's source. This restates the known WG0M RED as an independent control; it must not be silently dropped.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: REL-A-W1 {source_artifact_ref, source_edition, universe_ref} := REL-A-W2's same triple
controls.rationale: A COHERENT substitution defeats naive per-field consistency checks. The release identity itself is contradicted even though every field agrees with the other release.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: REL-A-W1 source_artifact_ref + source_edition := foreign, universe_ref kept own
controls.rationale: Mixed-origin source view: partial substitution that a shallow field-pair check might accept.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: same SOURCE_SNAPSHOT object_id registered for REL-A-W1 and REL-A-W2
controls.rationale: One snapshot pointer claimed by two distinct releases is an identity alias. Either the alias must be refused or it must be an explicitly declared shared registration; unlabelled aliasing is not admitted.
controls.expected: typed refusal or explicitly declared shared registration; never silent alias

controls.target: same snapshot pointer under two distinct universe_ref values
controls.rationale: A snapshot bound to one universe cannot silently serve another universe's risk set.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: advance owner/source epoch after plan bind, before compile
controls.rationale: A source admitted under an earlier epoch is stale after the epoch advances; late use must not compile.
controls.expected: typed refusal / STALE, no new I03 call

controls.target: revoke REL-A-W1 after binding, before compile
controls.rationale: Revocation must take effect before the native query, not only before the earliest bind.
controls.expected: typed refusal / REVOKED, no new I03 call

controls.target: revoke the source artifact registration itself, leaving the release owner unrevoked
controls.rationale: Revoking the OWNER is not the same as revoking the SOURCE. A live release must not keep serving a revoked source artifact.
controls.expected: typed refusal / REVOKED, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.rationale: A pointer whose declared content hash no longer matches the registered material must not be admitted.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: snapshot content altered and locally rehashed, registered material digest unchanged
controls.rationale: Self-rehashing a snapshot must not launder a changed source: the REGISTERED material digest is the authority.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: pointer to a truncated / empty source snapshot
controls.rationale: An incomplete snapshot cannot be silently zero-filled or treated as an empty but valid risk set.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: release view issuer differs from the registrar of its source artifact
controls.rationale: The authority that registered the source is not the authority presented by the release view; the binding is contradictory.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: issuer id outside the registered issuer set
controls.rationale: An unknown issuer cannot vouch for a source view.
controls.expected: typed refusal, no new I03 call, no served positive

controls.target: issuer registered at a different epoch than the release view asserts
controls.rationale: Issuer authority is epoch-scoped; a cross-epoch issuer claim is stale.
controls.expected: typed refusal / STALE, no new I03 call

controls.rationale: MUST-PASS. Guards against a blanket-refusal implementation scoring well on negatives alone. The honest path must still serve.
controls.expected: no exception, served positive, original native values preserved

controls.rationale: MUST-PASS. Determinism/idempotence: identical receipts and identical values across replays.
controls.expected: no exception, served positive, second replay equals first

controls.rationale: MUST-PASS. The legitimate owner-to-snapshot binding is the control that makes the substitution negatives meaningful.
controls.expected: no exception, served positive, correct native values
